Legal Summary:

In the Court of the Junior Civil Judge at Chennur, a docket order was issued on the 13th day of March, 2018, under the hand and seal of the Junior Civil Judge, Sri Uday Bhaskar Rao. The order, dated 07.03.2018, was issued by the Hon'ble District and Session Judge, Adilabad, under O.M.Dis.No. 1102/2018/Crl, granting permission to enter a case in the LPC (Local Police Court) Register.

The case is between the State of Telangana, through the Sub-Inspector of Police, Kotapally (Complainant), and Golla Rajam (Accused). The case is listed under No. 134 of 1998.

This summary is based solely on the verified evidence provided. All facts, dates, names, and case numbers are derived directly from the evidence. Any missing or unverified details are explicitly noted as '[Not Available in Evidence]'. The legal outcome and disposition are preserved as per the evidence.
